concerns.text: T022b (Global Covariance) depends on T037 (Data Ingestion). T037 explicitly raises RuntimeError if real data is missing and synthetic fallback is disabled in research mode. The Spec (FR-002) and Plan (Sampling Strategy Case A) require the pipeline to handle missing data via synthetic generation or fail gracefully. T022b has no task to generate synthetic data or handle the T037 failure state, creating a deadlock where the global covariance metric cannot be computed if real data is absent, violating FR-002 and SC-005.

T027d (Model Selection) sets model_type='fail' for N<30 but does not include a task to generate the required 'failure report' in results.json or quickstart.md as mandated by the Plan's 'Adaptive Model Selection' strategy. The Spec (SC-001, SC-002) requires reporting R² and MAE; a 'fail' state without a specific task to output the 'unsupported' hypothesis status and failure metrics leaves SC-001/SC-002 unfulfilled for small datasets.

T030c (Null Baseline) requires a paired t-test on MAE, but there is no task to implement the 'paired t-test' logic or the 'DummyRegressor' baseline training if N < 30 (where T027d sets model_type='fail'). The pipeline would crash or skip this step, failing to satisfy SC-002 (Null Baseline Comparison) for the failure case.

T014 (Primary Dimension Identification) implements a 'fallback rule' (use column if present) instead of the strict exclusion mandated by FR-006 and the Spec's 'Exclusion Rule'. The task description says 'If both fail, exclude', but the 'Secondary Rule' allows using a column that might be derived from model scores, violating FR-003 (independence) and SC-004 (target independence) if the column is not strictly metadata-based. A task to strictly enforce metadata-only derivation is missing.

The 'Notes' section contains a contradictory 'CRITICAL' note: 'T022a-core must generate data/processed/lineage_report.json' (which is actually T024's output) and 'T022a must read the dominant eigenvalue... and include it as a per-sample feature', which directly contradicts the T022a task body ('Do NOT append the dominant eigenvalue'). This stale/contradictory tag creates confusion and must be removed or corrected to match the task body.
